webDerivative.reason: The repository has no governed WebP conversion step. No derivative is fabricated and no browser conversion dependency is introduced.

provenance.workflow: The owner delivered an already cut-out transparent PNG in an asset-library archive. Claude Code ran only the deterministic local alpha-bbox extract and the 1024 square normalization. No Adobe processing was applied in this pass.

board.reason: The owner archive shares a name with an Adobe board, but the association is not verifiable from the delivered file, so no board is claimed.

selectedGeneration.requestIdReason: The file arrived through an owner-supplied archive; no generation request is observable from it.

masterProcessing.toneTarget: not re-aligned in this pass; the delivered cutout was accepted as authored
masterProcessing.cameraAxisNote: D076 specifies one isometric 45 degree axis for every layer. The delivered set is not uniform on that axis; this is recorded rather than corrected, because camera angle is not something image editing can fix.
